fusions.name: Writ of Teeth
fusions.desc: Brings your jaws down on the target, dealing 30 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Quelling Roar
fusions.desc: Roars over every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 9 damage with a 40% chance of [Damped] for 5 seconds. Costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Standing Order
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 20% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Undisturbed Court
fusions.desc: While you are at full health, your next ability deals 25% more damage. Once every 12 seconds.
